recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current build-scope ServiceRequest source already preserves the approved FHIR-3739 behavior, and adding a redundant explicit DocumentReference target or editing retired DiagnosticOrder source would not improve the current specification.
issue_request: FHIR-3739 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 OO issue asking DiagnosticOrder.supportingInformation to permit DocumentReference in addition to Condition and Observation and to change the element short name to Additional Clinical information.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in commit d6259fa8e3beda8fd5e58ad54d85001f1efb9d42, which changed DiagnosticOrder.supportingInformation to Reference(Observation|Condition|DocumentReference), changed the short text to Additional clinical information, and tagged the spreadsheet row with [#3739].
additional_context: DiagnosticOrder is no longer a current build resource; source/fhir.ini records it as subsumed into ServiceRequest. Later source history renamed supportingInformation to supportingInfo, merged DiagnosticRequest into ProcedureRequest, renamed ProcedureRequest to ServiceRequest, changed ServiceRequest.supportingInfo to CodeableReference(Resource), and clarified supportingInfo wording without removing DocumentReference support.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml carries the [#3739] committee note, has short Additional clinical information, and uses CodeableReference(Resource), which includes DocumentReference through the Resource target profile.

related_jiras.note: Aligned DiagnosticRequest with the request pattern and renamed supportingInformation to supportingInfo while retaining the FHIR-3739 lineage.
Merged DiagnosticRequest into ProcedureRequest, carrying the supportingInfo element forward.
Renamed ProcedureRequest to ServiceRequest, establishing the current active successor resource.
Changed ServiceRequest.supportingInfo to CodeableReference(Resource), preserving DocumentReference support through the Resource target.
Clarified ServiceRequest.supportingInfo wording while preserving the target type and short text relevant to FHIR-3739.
